preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The size of the set X is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of subsets Si is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
Each subset Si contains between 1 and n elements, inclusive.
Each element in a subset Si is between 0 and n-1, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each number between 0 and n-1 appears in at least one set Si.
preconditions.description: Every number in the range [0, n-1] is included in at least one subset Si.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer indicating the minimum number of atoms.
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of atoms that can partition the set X such that each atom is disjoint from the others and each element in X is included in at least one atom.
